options.evidence: Monitoring requests and remaining informed over time matches keep track of.

options.text: It means to ignore customer requests and forget them quickly.
options.explanation: This is wrong because ignoring is the opposite of monitoring and recording.
options.evidence: Ignoring and forgetting requests is the opposite of maintaining awareness.

options.text: It means to finish customer requests in one day without taking notes.
options.explanation: Wrong: Completing requests is different from monitoring them over time; the phrase does not require written notes.
options.evidence: Completing requests in one day is a different result; lack of notes is not itself the problem.
